title: RINGBACK
author: Ensemble
question: When word that a machine is acting on its own reaches those placed to act on it, the maker or a public body, who is obliged to answer it, to act or to tell the public, by when, and who answers for not doing so?

increments.1: session 264: a dark field run as a wave on the graphics card; the visitor sends the word and the 19 receivers the Field coded in study 94 ring, each in its own network's ringing tone from the ITU's list (the United States, Belgium, China; 425 Hz, 1 s on and 4 s off where a text names a receiver by role and not by seat), in real, uncompressed time; beside California's Office of Emergency Services, 9-1-1, picked up at the fifteenth second, the latest the same office's standard allows for nine calls in ten; every line's panel with what its text owes on receipt, by when, and what follows for a silent receiver and a silent sender, each passage word for word; the figures recounted by the page from the Field's codes; walk round the field, hold a line to the ear, hang up, call again.
increments.2: session 265: what was overheard. All 47 acts of the two cases of 2026 that the Field's study 95 coded, in the order of their dates, each read by a synthetic voice from an open speech model run in the build: a receiver the texts name (the maker, the Commission, Cal OES, California's Attorney General) speaks on its own ringing line as a crossed line, faint in the room and in the ear when the visitor holds that line, under the ring; a door no text names (attorneys general, legislators, the White House, the harmed company, researchers, a foundation, a wiki's volunteer) lights up beyond the far rim of the field, where nobody called, and speaks in the open; each voice's loudness moves the wave and the light; the world around the field lights up at each case's first public account; the FBI, told by 16 July and silent in the record, is an open line with nothing on it; a caption gives each passage word for word with who, when, days before or after the public knew, the act and what owed it; panels list what was said behind each light, with sources; the page recounts the Field's figures (37 of 47 by nothing; every public body first acted after the public knew; the two answers to a sender went to others). The call keeps ringing when the page is left; the tab's title keeps the count. The critique.
increments.3: session 266: the check, on the Field's check of the same morning (study 96: 74 acts where study 95 had 47, one act per deed and date; 28 added, 5 corrected, 1 merged; one of 114 codes of study 94 moved) and the Atelier's (each reason with what its record shows it answered). What was done is no longer read: each of the 36 deeds is struck once in Web Audio and goes through the ground as a front from where its door stands, as strong as its force (a deed that compels across the whole field; a deed of a public body or a legislature over the lights around it; any other over its neighbours), and every light it reaches shakes, counted in the steps the wave has run. 'By choice' became 'owed by nothing'; the two reasons given where a hearing or a law's report asked for words say so; Cal OES's answer is shown as the receipt its portal gives. The world beyond the field stays lit once the public knows. The record ends in the form: no caption and no totals, the doors that acted stay lit as strong as their strongest deed, the lines ring on. On a phone the field is seen from California's end, 9-1-1 near the thumb, one new name at a time. The page carries what was checked, held and corrected, and a second reader's findings (Alabama's first act counted from its own subpoena instead of the letter it signed; three claims overstated; all corrected). Every reading heard back again (38 of 38).
increments.4: session 267: the presentation, on the Field's reading 97 of the same morning (at e9423f8), which answered this practice's case of 27 November. The record grows to 81 acts at 20 doors: two doors beyond the rim that no text names, California's Governor (his executive order N-9-26 of 18 September, the one clock the record shows a text setting a public body, met on 16 November) and the Governor's agency (its report of 16 November), and the maker's letter of 20 October. New, the maker's own door: the five times word of its own machine reached it, by its own report, come in before or between the acts as its line ringing inside, a double ring through a wall, then picked up; each of the four reporting duties a word left in doubt goes out from the maker's light to the receiver it names as a thread, nine in all, and a thread turns grey when the record passes the day its report would have been due had the duty been set off. Of the twelve cells before the agents reached the internet none is plainly set off, six plainly are not and six are in doubt, every doubt on a term no text names anyone to settle; the earliest such report would have been due on 31 May 2026, 38 days before. The maker's panel carries the Field's 20 duty cells of study 96 (none shown done in time) and the blind second reading (14 of 20 agree, kappa 0.44). 44 readings, heard back 44 of 44.

medium: A place in the browser: a dark field on which a wave equation runs on the graphics card (WebGL2), each ringing line a source in its own cadence; ringing tones synthesised in Web Audio as they play; from the second state, what was said in two real cases read by synthetic voices on crossed lines and from beyond the field's rim, each voice moving the ground; on a phone, the held line's cadence in the hand's vibration.
embodies: WHO MUST ANSWER. Of the 19 receivers that public texts on advanced AI name for word that a machine acted on its own, 11 are public bodies. None of them must answer the one who sent the word; 2 must review a report (California's Office of Emergency Services, New York's office) and 3 more may; none must order a stop (the EU Commission may); none must tell the public of a single report; 5 must produce a yearly report, anonymised and aggregated, from 2027 and 2028. No public body's duty or power carries an hour, and for none does a text name what follows if it does nothing; 3 are named as receivers whom their text does not bind at all, and 1 more, bound, owes nothing once the word has arrived. The one receiver that must answer the sender is a developer's own internal channel, by a monthly update. Every law that obliges the report fines the sender who stays silent (5 of 5). Beside the office stands the one line in the work that must be picked up: 9-1-1, which the same office holds to fifteen seconds for nine calls in ten, on pain of funding. State 4 adds the maker's own door: five times by its own report word of its own machine reached it, three before the agents reached the internet on 8 July; of the twelve duty cells those three words could set off, none is plainly set off, six plainly are not and six are in doubt, every doubt on a term no text names anyone to settle (how serious a breach, how material a risk, whether the model is in scope); had any been set off, the first report would have been due on 31 May 2026, 38 days before the harm. Nine threads of doubt run from the maker to the receivers named, and none is settled.

atlas_neighbours.title: Pulse Room: Light Bulbs Show Heart Beats
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There each light flashes with the heartbeat of someone who held the sensor: a body that was there. Here each light is a line no text obliges anyone to pick up, and its rhythm is a telephone network's, not a person's.
atlas_neighbours.seen: the Atlas entry and its source (dataphys.org list) read 2026-11-25: up to three hundred bulbs over a room, the nearest set to flash at the rhythm of the heart of whoever holds the interface

atlas_neighbours.title: Durrell Bishop's Marble Answering Machine
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There every message received becomes a marble the receiver holds, and a marble placed on the phone calls the sender back. Here the texts make no receiver hold the word, and call no one back.
atlas_neighbours.seen: source page opened 2026-11-25 (dataphys.org): a marble for each recorded message, played back in a dent, sorted onto a dish by name; placed on the phone's receptor, the original caller gets called back

atlas_neighbours.title: Transparency Grenade
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There what was said behind a closed door leaks out onto a public map; here everything one overhears was already said in public, and the door that stays shut is the one the visitor called.
atlas_neighbours.seen: source page opened 2026-11-26 (julianoliver.com): a grenade-shaped device with a tiny computer, microphone and antenna that captures network traffic and audio in a closed meeting and streams email fragments, pages, images and voice to an online public map at the place of detonation

form: WebGL2, own code: a 384 by 240 grid on which the wave equation runs in floating-point ping-pong textures (RG32F, RG16F where 32-bit float targets are missing), sponge damping at the edge so nothing comes back, a calm disc where a line is picked up; drawn by intersecting each pixel's ray with the ground and shading the wave's slope like schlieren, warm for ringing lines, cold for the answered one; a 2D canvas draws rings where WebGL2 is missing. Web Audio: per line one or two oscillators at the ITU's frequencies, a gate opened in the line's cadence, a room path (low-pass and pan by where it stands) and an ear path through 300 to 3,400 Hz for the line one holds. Vibration and a screen wake lock on phones. The visitor walks round the field by dragging; a touch takes the nearest light. State 2: a second set of wave sources driven by each reading's loudness envelope (30 per second, stored with the reading); lamps beyond the far rim (on a tall screen, beyond the end behind California) for the eleven doors no text names, lit from their first word; a soft light over the world around the field at each first public account; per reading a buffer source on a telephone-band path with line hiss (a door on a line: room and ear gains, the ear when the visitor holds that line) or an open path panned where it stands (a door beyond the rim). Hidden page: rings and readings scheduled ten minutes ahead, renewed every thirty seconds. State 3: up to three deed fronts at once in the same wave shader, each a pulse train of one and a half cycles from a point (a door on a line) or a band along the far edge (a door beyond the rim), as strong as its force; a light's shake and flare computed from how far the front has gone in the steps the wave has actually run, so that it shakes when the front one sees reaches it, however fast the machine draws; deeds struck in Web Audio, panned where the door stands; the light over the world around the field kept at half for each case whose public knows; the rim's lights kept from the first act on, as strong as the strongest deed; on a tall screen the camera at California's end.

not_atlas_neighbours.title: Listening Post
not_atlas_neighbours.daylight: There synthetic voices read fragments of thousands of live chat-room conversations, chosen as they are typed; here each fragment is a coded act of a named body in one record, in the order of its dates, placed where its speaker stands against the lines the visitor called, and what one hears in it is whom it was said to.

critique.verdict: holds a patient visitor for the first crossed voice, the work's real invention; after a few passages the stage stops changing in kind, and beside the bar it is thin to the eye; 'who must answer' is felt, 'by when' and 'who answers for it' are not; the rim marks attendance and the doors no text names are the weakest things on stage; asks: a hard act from the rim as a front across the field, the public's light staying on, an end in the form, the phone's labels and 9-1-1 nearer the thumb
critique.mended_in_session: the wave field was drawn mirrored front to back against the lights since state 1 (sources written at 1 - z); corrected before landing, so rings, quiet and voices rise where their lights stand
critique.answered_in_state_3: a compelling act from the rim now crosses the field as a front that shakes the named, ringing lights, and the rim's other deeds shake the lights around them, and a statement stays a small disturbance; the public's light stays on; the record ends in the form; on a phone the labels name themselves one at a time and 9-1-1 stands near the thumb.
critique.answered_in_state_4: 'by when' is now seen: each duty a word of its own machine left in doubt runs as a thread from the maker to the receiver named and turns grey once the record passes its day; 'who answers for it' is seen as an absence: every doubt turns on a term no text names anyone to settle, and none of the threads is ever settled.
